tasks.instruction_text: Book the cheapest economy LOT Polish Airlines round-trip from Warsaw, Poland to New York City, USA — Jan 21, 2026 outbound, Feb 21, 2026 return. The autocomplete shows several New York options (JFK, NYC all airports, EWR, LGA); pick JFK. Set both calendar dates.
Same Warsaw → New York LOT round-trip but for Aug 20, 2026 → Aug 28, 2026. Destination must resolve to JFK (not EWR/LGA). Calendar needs to advance from May 2026 to August.
Book the LOT flight from Warsaw to JFK for Mar 5, 2027 returning Mar 19, 2027 (calendar needs ~10 months of advance). The autocomplete must resolve to JFK specifically, not NYC all-airports.
One-way LOT flight from Warsaw to JFK on Oct 4, 2026. Pick the JFK entry and set Oct 4, 2026 in the calendar — no return.
What's the cheapest LOT fare shown for Warsaw → JFK on Jan 21, 2026? Reply as $X (e.g. $468).
How many nonstop LOT options are there from Warsaw to JFK on Jan 21, 2026? Reply with the integer followed by 'nonstop' (e.g. '2 nonstop').
What's the flight number for the cheapest LOT Warsaw → JFK Jan 21, 2026 service? Reply with the flight number in quotes (e.g. "LO 27").
Configure: destination JFK, depart Jan 21, 2026, return Feb 21, 2026. Then report the cheapest fare shown for that exact route in $X form.
Set the Warsaw → JFK search for Apr 12, 2027 → Apr 26, 2027. Report the LOT flight number for that depart in quotes (e.g. "LO 33").
Final: set destination JFK and dates May 22, 2027 → Jun 5, 2027 (~12 calendar advances). Report the LOT fare in $X form.
